item.description:
Marktechpost ranks the 9 best AI gateways for 2026. We compare Bifrost, Portkey, LiteLLM, Kong, TrueFoundry, Cloudflare, Vercel, OpenRouter and Orq.ai on latency, pricing, licensing, governance and deployment.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents
item.description:
Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, an open-weight 24B Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters. It targets local agents, scoring 48.09 on LiveClaw and decoding 184 tokens/s on an Apple M5 Max.

The post Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon API With 1M Token Output Limit
item.description:
Google has made Gemini 4 Argon generally available on the Gemini API, AI Studio and the Gemini app. The sparse MoE model writes up to 1M output tokens and leads the Vals Index at 68.90%.

The post Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon API With 1M Token Output Limit appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meta Launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: Benchmarks, Pricing and How to Use It
item.description:
Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, 1M-context agent models. Muse Wonder costs $4/$20 per million tokens on Meta Model API. Wonder Full, on Muse Code plans, leads DeepSWE and SWE-Marathon.

The post Meta Launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: Benchmarks, Pricing and How to Use It appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: How to Use Meta’s Rebalancer for Task Placement & Optimization
item.description:
In this comprehensive coding tutorial, we explore Meta's Rebalancer assignment solver using its C++ core and Python bindings. Learn how to build datacenters, manage task placements across racks, handle constraints and goal priorities, and compare local search against the exact HiGHS solver using published benchmarks.

item.title: Z.ai GLM-Legal Beats Claude Fable 5 and Kimi K3 on Harvey LAB
item.description:
Z.ai’s GLM-Legal is a legal AI model built on GLM-5.3-Flash. It scores 19.2% all-pass on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark, nearly 3x its base, at $0.15 per test. Access is by application.

The post Z.ai GLM-Legal Beats Claude Fable 5 and Kimi K3 on Harvey LAB appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Alibaba Qwen Introduces QwenGyre: Elastic Reinforcement Learning RL for XLong-Horizon Agents
item.description:
Alibaba’s Qwen team has introduced QwenGyre, an elastic reinforcement learning RL framework for extreme-long-horizon agent training. QwenGyre is an online reinforcement learning system from Alibaba that trains coding agents through unmodified, black-box harnesses. item.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
item.description:
TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available.

The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text
item.description:
Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an Apache-2.0 multimodal decision model built on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. It scores text, images, audio and video in one call for $0.15 per million input tokens, while Clef-flash drops to $0.038.

The post Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text appeared first on MarkTechPost.
